description.zh:
证书ID。
CertType=cas时必填，表示选择已有证书。
description.en: The ID of the certificate. This parameter is required if you set CertType to cas.

description.zh:
证书名称，目前只支持单个证书名称。
CertType=upload时选填，给新证书的名称。
description.en: The name of the certificate. You can specify only one certificate name. This parameter is optional if you set CertType to upload.

description.zh: 证书所在地域，只有**CertType=cas**时生效。支持**cn-hangzhou**和**ap-southeast-1**，默认**cn-hangzhou**。国际站用户建议使用**ap-southeast-1**。
description.en: The region of the certificate. This parameter takes effect only when **CertType is set to cas**. Valid values: **cn-hangzhou** and **ap-southeast-1**. Default value: **cn-hangzhou**. **ap-southeast-1** is recommended for users on the International site.

description.zh:
证书类型。

- **upload**：上传证书。
- **cas**：证书中心证书。
description.en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

- **upload**: custom certificate

- **cas**: a certificate that is acquired through Certificate Management Service.

description.zh: 指定证书所属加速域名，需属于HTTPS加速类型。仅支持单个域名。
description.en: The accelerated domain name for which you want to configure the SSL certificate. The type of request supported by the domain name must be HTTPS. You can specify only one domain name in each request.

description.zh: 私钥内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入私钥内容。
description.en: The private key. Specify the private key only if you want to enable the certificate.

description.zh:
HTTPS证书是否启用。

- **on**：启用。
- **off**：不启用。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the SSL certificate.

- **on**

- **off**

description.zh: 安全证书内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入证书内容。
description.en: The certificate content. Specify the certificate content only if you want to enable the certificate.

descriptions.zh:
- 单用户调用频率：30次/秒。
- 调用方式：POST。
descriptions.en:
- Each account can call this operation up to 30 times per second.

- Method: POST.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn set-cdn-domain-ssl-certificate --domain-name example.com --cert-name yourCertName --cert-id 8089870 --cert-type upload --ssl-protocol off --ssl-pub xxx --ssl-pri y0000 --cert-region cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cdn SetCdnDomainSSLCertificate --region cn-hangzhou --DomainName 'example.com' --CertId 8089870 --SSLPub xxx --CertRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --CertType upload --CertName yourCertName --SSLPri y0000 --SSLProtocol off
